title: cordylanthus rigidus subsp. littoralis
intro: Cordylanthus rigidus subsp. littoralis, commonly known as Littoral Purple Needlegrass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the figwort family. This plant is used in herbal medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cordylanthus rigidus subsp. littoralis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that may help to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. While research is ongoing, the bioactive constituents of this plant may also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, supporting its traditional use in herbal medicine.
